svg.title: The tour, in thirty seconds
svg.desc: Eight steps: a real change is submitted, rejected, fixed, tested and accepted before it merges.
svg.metadata: [{"text":"pullboard tour: a coordinator and two scripted agents run real commands on a throwaway repo. No model runs.","at":81},{"text":"1 The person approved one spec row. The coordinator files it as work.","at":3973},{"text":" G1: greet(name) returns \"Hello, <name>!\"; a blank name greets the world: \"Hello, world!\"","at":3973},{"text":" coordinator $ pullboard add app Greeting --specs G1 --criterion \"greet() meets G1\"","at":4383},{"text":" #1","at":4536},{"text":"2 A builder agent gets its own worktree in the app lane and claims the next item. Its criterion freezes.","at":5745},{"text":" coordinator $ pullboard worktree app","at":6150},{"text":" made greeter-app-1 on branch app/1, joined as app-1 in the app lane","at":6548},{"text":" app-1 $ pullboard next","at":6956},{"text":" claimed #1: Greeting","at":7225},{"text":" criterion: greet() meets G1","at":7225},{"text":"3 It writes greet(), tests the happy path and submits. Its own gate is green.","at":8430},{"text":" app-1 $ git commit -q -m \"feat(app): greet by name [G1]\"","at":9252},{"text":" app-1 $ pullboard submit 1","at":10690},{"text":" submitted #1 at 4c2b69e3da47; gate green in 0s","at":11199},{"text":"4 A second agent checks out exactly that commit and tries the edge the builder skipped.","at":12400},{"text":" coordinator $ pullboard worktree review","at":12811},{"text":" made greeter-review-1 on branch review/1, joined as review-1 in the review lane","at":13080},{"text":" review-1 $ git switch -q --detach 4c2b69e3da47","at":13489},{"text":" review-1 $ node -e \"greet('')\"","at":13910},{"text":" Hello, !","at":13940},{"text":" review-1 $ pullboard verify 1 reject --reason BEHAVIOR_MISMATCH --note \"greet('') returns \\\"Hello, !\\\"; G1 says a blank name greets the world\"","at":14347},{"text":" rejected #1: BEHAVIOR_MISMATCH; it is open again for rework","at":14558},{"text":"5 The builder's next session starts from the board, not from memory.","at":15767},{"text":" app-1 $ pullboard resume","at":16175},{"text":" sent back: #1 BEHAVIOR_MISMATCH by review-1: greet('') returns \"Hello, !\"; G1 says a blank name greets the world","at":16437},{"text":" next: pullboard claim 1, fix what the verifier found, and submit again","at":16437},{"text":"6 It fixes the edge, adds a test that pins it, and submits a new commit.","at":17637},{"text":" app-1 $ pullboard claim 1","at":18043},{"text":" claimed #1 until 2026-10-06T14:00:00.000Z; criterion frozen as a26fca30b8d4","at":18263},{"text":" app-1 $ git commit -q -am \"fix(app): a blank name greets the world [G1]\"","at":18668},{"text":" app-1 $ pullboard submit 1","at":19488},{"text":" submitted #1 at 68f78e1c728d; gate green in 0s","at":19871},{"text":"7 The verifier breaks the fix on purpose, to prove the new test can fail, then restores it and accepts.","at":21080},{"text":" review-1 $ git switch -q --detach 68f78e1c728d","at":21483},{"text":" review-1 $ node --test # with the fix removed","at":21908},{"text":" # pass 1","at":21978},{"text":" # fail 1","at":21978},{"text":" review-1 $ git checkout -- src/greet.mjs","at":22379},{"text":" review-1 $ pullboard verify 1 accept --note \"removed the blank-name fix: its new test failed; restored, both pass\"","at":22800},{"text":" verified #1: CRITERION_MET","at":23038},{"text":"8 The coordinator merges it. The ledger is the receipt.","at":24248},{"text":" coordinator $ git merge -q --ff-only app/1","at":24650},{"text":" coordinator $ pullboard merged 1 68f78e1c728d","at":25087},{"text":" #1 merged as 68f78e1c728d","at":25207},{"text":" coordinator $ pullboard ledger","at":25609},{"text":" 1 verified by a second agent · 0 awaiting verification · 1 rejection along the way","at":25698},{"text":" | # | Lane | Item | Spec | Built by | Verified by | Commit | Merged |","at":25698},{"text":" | 1 | app | Greeting | G1 | app-1 | review-1 | 68f78e1c728d | 68f78e1c728d |","at":25698},{"text":"Nothing shipped until a second agent verified it.","at":25698},{"text":" Look around: cd greeter && pullboard log","at":25698}]

g.title: G1: greet(name) returns "Hello, <name>!"; a blank name greets the world: "Hello, world!"
g.text: approve one spec row: greet a blank name as "world"

g.title: The person approved one spec row. The coordinator files it as work.
A builder agent gets its own worktree in the app lane and claims the next item. Its criterion freezes. It writes greet(), tests the happy path and submits. Its own gate is green.
g.text: claims it, builds greet(), submits with tests green

g.title: A second agent checks out exactly that commit and tries the edge the builder skipped.: BEHAVIOR_MISMATCH
The builder's next session starts from the board, not from memory.
g.text: reads why from the board, not from memory.

g.title: It fixes the edge, adds a test that pins it, and submits a new commit.
g.text: fixes it, adds a test that pins it, submits again

g.title: The verifier breaks the fix on purpose, to prove the new test can fail, then restores it and accepts.: CRITERION_MET
g.text: breaks the fix on purpose, sees the test fail

g.title: The coordinator merges it. The ledger is the receipt.
g.text: merges it; the ledger is the receipt.

svg.text: Real commands on a throwaway repo. No model runs.
